title: Morgana Static Dungeon PVE meta
author: whitefirewolf
description:
# 5-Man Morgana Static META compositon

## Structure

Each weapon build have **Gears and Skills** and **How to play** section, so if you looking for a particular weapon just click on it.

## General Info

This composition focuses on fast clearing of the dungeon. The whole run usually takes 1 hour. When clearing I usually go for the chests only while clearing mobs on the way, compared to full clear fame farming. There is a total 3 floors including outside of the Static Dungeon. On the usual run there is 2 chests outside, 12 chests on the B1 aka the first floor and 4 chests on B2 aka the second floor. Sometimes there is extra chests spawn in preternatural locations but it's negligibly rare.

### Potion

Everyone should be on at least  **3.1 Calming potion**. **3.0 Calming potion** works only on one person. **3.1 Calming potion** works on up to 5 allies including yourself, so if you are more than 5 people, for example 6 or 7 and you want to reset the mob's aggro for the whole group use **3.2 Calming potion**. Another option would be to use **3.1 Calming potion** 2 times.

## FAQ

### Druid cowl?

This compositon focuses on fast clearing, so if you check out gears for each **DPS** I recommend using **Lymhurst Cape**, **Energetic** Weapon passive skill or **Efficiency** passive skill on cloth armor in case you feel like you lack energy. Other gears  like **Head** piece and **Chest** piece focuses more on getting reduced **Cooldowns** for the fast clearing speed.

### Item A is better than B

There is a lot of different compositions and opinions, I would suggest just using what **Tank** or **Party leader/Content Host** asks. Most important thing is that the **Build** makes the job done.

### Free weapon choice

If there is more than five players, 6th player and beyond are on what is called **"Free Weapon"**. **Permafrost, Arctic, Longbow, Greafire, Realbreaker, Mistpiercer** are all examples of a good **free weapons**. In general **AOE Range DPS** is a good choice. I like **Realmbreaker** despite it being **Melee DPS** because of the burst damage and debuff it can apply to mobs.

title: Static Dungeon
author: ToasterOwO
description:
### General Information:
**Equipment:** 4.3 Set (1200 IP)
**Cost:** Roughly 700k-1.2m in Asia Server.

The system is fairly simple, if you're new to this try to stick to the exact items till you reach level 100. Once there you can keep it turn future fame into credits or start making tiny adjustments to the build like swapping out a shoe, helmet etc to just level it up. (Do note that you should point out you're making adjustments to the build)

At the beginning you might get knocked down a lot but that's normally everyone went through that, after a little while it's the same thing over and over again so the only cost from then is just the potions and food you bring.

### Note
If you're like I want to spec up my axe or whatever, please don't. You make life harder for others with odd items. Do it when playing with friends or by asking beforehand if it's okay to bring.

title: Group Tracking Builds
author: ToasterOwO
description:
### Basic Requirement:
Equipment: 1250-1300 IP (Minimum)
Build: Keep it as is, don't change and ruin efficiency.
Tool: Bring highest you can have, it's free exp for everyone who has the tool.

### Words of Wisdom:
Tracking is quite simple and makes good money. After a few try it's just the same thing over and over again so you just go in, do the deed and earn yourself some juicy silver. A 5 man party is the most common but ideal would of 4 man. Also you can solo track at odd hours to help level up tracking so that bosses run away less. (You can use learning point as it's a very tiny amount that gets used)

Only let the person with the highest track level start the hunt otherwise the bosses will keep on running away. Once started you can help find the track faster.

Also try to spread out in Avalonian road in like East, West, North, South to just find all the tracks the zone has available before starting is a good way to be efficient about it. Do note that Ava Road is a lot safer and easier than Outlands.

title: Comp Brawl 7 vs 7 caminos de Avalon
author: SiberiamHusky
description:
Estrategia de Brawl (7v7) - Caminos de Avalón

Esta composición está diseñada para dominar mediante el desgaste y la supervivencia sostenida. Nuestra prioridad es ganar la guerra de recursos a través de intercambios inteligentes y posicionamiento coordinado.

Ejecución:

-Gestión de Trades (Intercambios): Buscamos intercambios de daño favorables. Si el enemigo gasta sus habilidades principales (E) y nosotros sobrevivimos usando solo habilidades básicas o defensivos menores, hemos ganado el "trade". No perseguimos bajas desesperadamente; forzamos errores.

-Cohesión de Grupo: El equipo se mueve como un solo bloque. La dispersión es nuestra mayor debilidad. Si te alejas del rango de curación para intentar un "kill", regalas tu vida.

-Rotación de Defensivos: No solapamos (stackeamos) defensivos. Rotamos el uso de Pociones de Resistencia, Gigantismo y habilidades de pecho para mantener una línea de presión constante sin quedar vulnerables todos a la vez.

-Counter-Engage Dinámico: Aguantamos el impacto inicial del enemigo, estabilizamos vidas y contraatacamos inmediatamente cuando sus defensas o habilidades de escape están en enfriamiento.

-Control de Espacio en Chokes: Aprovechamos la geografía de los Caminos para forzar al enemigo a recibir daño mientras intenta avanzar, castigando su posicionamiento con daño de área y sangrados.

Ganamos por agotamiento. Cada habilidad enemiga desperdiciada en un escudo o una curación eficiente nos acerca a la victoria. Paciencia, rotación y trades superiores.

title: Imperial Decree Budget Group Fame Farm Build Collection
author: ThaiSweetChili
description:
These are some strong, easy to use and budget friendly builds we can run together to breeze through the group content, whether it be Group/Static Dungeons, Group/Faction camps, or Blue Chests in Roads. 

Use these builds as inspiration for your own, feel free to swap some of the weapons/armour out and see what works best for you and the group. 

If we are in safe zone feel free to go for some more expensive builds as they will most likely be more effective. 
(Swapping out the 2H Fire Staff for Blazing Staff for example, or the Longbow for Bow of Badon will make the content much easier/faster.)

These builds are all PvE focused, even so, as they are so cheap, we always have the option to head out to RZ/BZ/Roads without risking much.

Bear in mind we will struggle to fight a co-ordinated team with more PvP focused builds.

title: Reckonz 7 man One-Shot
author: Reckonz
description:
This one-shot comp focuses on long-range DPS with ranged damage dealers while tanks and D-tanks control space from a distance. It relies on low cooldown rotations, Cleanse Potions, Crossbow new W, Off-Guard Rune, and the 20m Pole Hammer E to maintain constant pressure without hard diving.

Against melee or dive comps, positioning and screen control are essential. Tanks and D-tanks prevent enemies from ever reaching the frontline by zoning, peeling, knocking back, and disrupting movement, allowing DPS to deal maximum-range damage safely.

The comp plays around short cooldown windows (15–25 seconds). DPS should call E cooldowns clearly, and engages are shallow or triggered by enemy mistakes rather than forced.

DPS and healers must never overextend or step into enemy tank range. Tanks and D-tanks focus on denying space, not deep commits. Bedrock W with Guard Rune is used offensively to let DPS free-cast safely, creating unavoidable damage with no effective counter, even against Great Arcane E.

title: Budget Friendly Roam
author: kuzu
description:
This budget friendly comp can do pretty much any content (albeit not efficiently) in open world and ava roads.
* recommended skills are for PVP scanario - swap when doing pve.
* ignite from fire enables the mace to gank.
* crystal mobs, camps n lairs, static, tracking, blue chest etc - cloth rdps allows for most pve.
* adopts kite play in PVP with help primarily from mace and demonic.
* take low tier res pot
* In Ava you can switch some weapons to true dmg like wildfire and skull if u lack specs yet want kills - PVE suffers.
* more roles can be added in this order - great hammer (replaces mace with heavy mace) - great arcane - blight - rdps/utility mdps
* play higher tier guardian armor and bring shield and soldier helmet swap as mace if u want to PVE better. Have ur DPS tier-up their weapon.

title: Group Tracking - PvE
author: CeJaay
description:
Group Tracking builds for Open world and roads. Group of 4-7.
Able to hold ground against other PvE groups and gankers in PvP.

For pure PvE comp, swap Cleric Robes for Druid Robes and one Royal Robe.

For Tank either Incubus Mace or Dreadstorm Monarch.

For Healer most holy staffs work: Holy Staff, Hallowfall, Fallen Staff and Redemption Staff.

For DPS there are more options like Lightcaller and Boltcasters you can go. However the options laid out in the build list, work well for both PvE clearing and if you end up in a PvP fight.

For Supports, only bring 1 support and only if group is 5-7 players. (Shadowcaller support also works, but "weaker" in PvP)
